hero.sub: A trusted bridge to global healthcare networks

intro: Daru Rasan Varna draws on a wide international trade network and close working relationships with established European and regional manufacturers. Our mission is to keep Iran's healthcare system and pharmaceutical manufacturers supplied without interruption. By following international transport standards closely and managing every trade document with care, we run a supply chain that is secure, fast and transparent.

items.title: Importing pharmaceutical products
points: Importing essential and specialty medicines to meet the direct needs of patients and treatment centres.
Managing the full supply chain from origin to destination, including oversight of compliant transport and an unbroken cold chain for temperature-sensitive medicines.
Working knowledge of regulatory protocols and customs procedures, so medicines clear quickly.

items.title: Sourcing pharmaceutical raw materials (APIs and excipients)
points: Sourcing and importing active ingredients and excipients that meet the highest international pharmacopoeia standards, to support Iran's domestic production lines.
Careful evaluation of foreign suppliers, and quality assurance for every material in line with the requirements of the Iran Food and Drug Administration.
Logistics planning and long-term international contracts that keep domestic production lines from stopping.
